_note: Product recommendations are PROPOSALS by this application (not workbook facts). 'preventability' is an ASSUMED share of the cause a pre-submission product change could remove; it is used only to rank themes and is editable here.

themes.name: Early name-match validation (PAN + bank)
themes.intervention: Fetch the PAN-registered name as soon as PAN is entered and pre-fill/lock the business name; run a bank-account name match (penny-drop name check) before submission and show the mismatch inline.
themes.operational_benefit: Removes the two name-mismatch rejections before a reviewer sees the file; fewer manual reviews and resubmission loops.

themes.name: Real-time GSTIN validation
themes.intervention: Validate GSTIN status, legal name and address against the GST registry while the merchant types; block inactive GSTINs with a clear message.
themes.operational_benefit: Catches wrong/inactive GSTINs instantly instead of after review.

themes.name: Instant bank-detail validation
themes.intervention: IFSC lookup with branch confirmation, account-number re-entry, and an immediate test-credit check with retry guidance.
themes.operational_benefit: Fewer failed test credits and support contacts at bank verification.

themes.name: Smart document capture
themes.intervention: On-device blur/crop/password detection and file-size check at upload, with retake guidance.
themes.operational_benefit: Unreadable documents are rejected at upload, not after review.

themes.name: Website readiness checklist + policy templates
themes.intervention: Automated pre-check of the submitted URL (live, no login wall, four policy pages present) plus ready-to-use T&C / Privacy / Refund / Contact page templates.
themes.operational_benefit: Merchants fix website gaps before submitting; reviewer time per website drops.

themes.name: Address-proof recency check
themes.intervention: Ask for the document date at upload and warn if older than 3 months or if the address differs from the application.

themes.name: Signatory details checklist
themes.intervention: Business-type-specific checklist of who the authorised signatory is, with name/DOB match against the uploaded ID.

themes.name: Guided business-category selection
themes.intervention: Suggest the category from the website content and ask the merchant to confirm before submission.
themes.operational_benefit: Fewer category/website mismatches sent for second review.

themes.name: Save-and-resume with step-specific reminders
themes.intervention: Persist partial progress, deep-link reminders to the exact step, and show a progress bar with what is left.
themes.operational_benefit: Addresses silent drop-off - a journey problem, not a document problem. Root cause of each abandonment is unknown, so preventability is assumed lower.

non_recoverable_note: R10 (restricted category) and R12 (compliance) are not product-fixable recovery causes. A signup-time category eligibility notice can save wasted effort for restricted businesses, but it must never suggest a workaround.
